why.a: Founder thesis, untested: two traditions that already share heat, acid, corn-and-fry technique and a fondness for sharing plates can be joined into dishes that feel like one cuisine, not two. Cultural advisor review is pending.

Founder thesis, untested: designing beer and food together makes pairing a reason to visit. Our own analysis says a host-brewery or collaboration path could test this with far less capital than a brewery.
Untested. The brewery is the LAST capital gate, after food, demand and economics are shown.
Founder choice; a market map from public sources exists at low confidence. No demand data.
